caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, long-sleeved dress with a high neckline. The dress is primarily cream-colored with alternating vertical panels. Some panels carry small, scattered floral motifs in soft colors, while other panels are decorated with narrow, vertical rows of small pink and blue flowers, bordered by light green leaves. The center bodice has a row of covered buttons and a triangular piece coming down to a point at the waist, with a similarly colored narrow trim running alongside the buttons. Brownish-tan ribbons are tied into bows at the elbows, and there are wide, white ruffled cuffs extending from beneath the elbow area. The collar is pointed and white, and the skirt of the dress is wide and bell-shaped, fanning outward. The general style suggests a historical European influence in fashion design, and the composition focuses only on the dress, with no human figure wearing it and no other objects in the background, which remains plain and unadorned.
title: Dress
